_notes: Gear by slot, in upgrade order. Stats are absolute values; the UI shows before -> after. cost 0 = starter, owned from the start. model = Agent G's gear manifest key <slot>.<itemId>. Lines have no model: material is how Agent A draws the line. 4.7b: rods have rating (kg the rod handles) and durability (strain points before it breaks; starter never breaks); lines have strength (kg) and wear (wear per hard fight, 0..1, re-spool at the shop); baits and lures are stacks (stack = how many come per purchase; breadcrust is free and unlimited); hooks, sinkers, floats and leaders are terminal tackle (lost on a snap unless the tackle box saves it); tools are owned, never equipped, always active.

splitcane.name: Grandpa's Splitcane
splitcane.flavour: It's caught more fish than you have.

driftwood_whip.name: Driftwood Whip
driftwood_whip.flavour: Cut from a branch that washed in from somewhere warmer.

greenheart.name: Harbourmaster's Greenheart
greenheart.flavour: Lent to every apprentice for a hundred years. Never once returned.

whalebone_arc.name: Whalebone Arc
whalebone_arc.flavour: Bends like a bow and hums when a big one runs.

tidecaster.name: Brass-Ferrule Tidecaster
tidecaster.flavour: The ferrules were cut from a sunken ship's bell. Sometimes it rings.

lighthouse_spar.name: Lighthouse Spar
lighthouse_spar.flavour: A spare from the lamp room. It still remembers the light.

click_reel.name: Rusty Click Reel
click_reel.flavour: Clicks like a cricket. Mostly still turns.

tinker_winch.name: Tinker's Brass Winch
tinker_winch.flavour: Built from a pocket watch and a grudge.

marigold_ratchet.name: Marigold Ratchet
marigold_ratchet.flavour: Salvaged from the Marigold. She sank; the ratchet didn't.

lantern_drum.name: Lantern-Drum Reel
lantern_drum.flavour: A little window in the drum glows brighter the harder a fish runs.

sextant_reel.name: Sextant Gear Reel
sextant_reel.flavour: Geared like a navigator's sextant. It counts every inch it wins back.

cotton_line.name: Mended Cotton Line
cotton_line.flavour: A knot every arm's length. Each knot is a story.

tarred_hemp.name: Tarred Hemp
tarred_hemp.flavour: Smells like the dock. Holds like the dock.

gutstring.name: Gutstring Twist
gutstring.flavour: Three strands, twisted by someone very patient.

silkweed_braid.name: Silkweed Braid
silkweed_braid.flavour: Braided from kelp that grows where the light runs out.

keepers_wire.name: Lighthouse Keeper's Wire
keepers_wire.flavour: Meant for the lamp. The keeper had other ideas.

breadcrust.name: Yesterday's Breadcrust
breadcrust.flavour: The gulls are furious about this.

sandworms.name: Low-Tide Sandworms
sandworms.flavour: Dug at dawn and still arguing about it.

glass_shrimp.name: Glass Shrimp
glass_shrimp.flavour: See-through, like the things that eat them.

tar_leech.name: Tar Leech
tar_leech.flavour: Black, sticky, and irresistible to anything old that lives on the bottom.

dusk_krill.name: Dusk Krill
dusk_krill.flavour: They glow faintly. The shy ones come out for them.

bent_pin.name: Bent Pin
bent_pin.flavour: Straightened twice, bent once more. It holds, mostly.

tinned_j.name: Tinned J-Hook
tinned_j.flavour: Bright tin over cheap iron. The fish don't know.

circle_hook.name: Fisherman's Circle
circle_hook.flavour: Curls back on itself, so the fish hooks itself.

barbed_bronze.name: Barbed Bronze
barbed_bronze.flavour: Cast from a ship's bell. Once in, it stays in.

pebble_sinker.name: Beach Pebble
pebble_sinker.flavour: Tied on with a clove hitch. Sinks, eventually.

split_shot.name: Split Shot
split_shot.flavour: Lead pellets pinched onto the line with your teeth.

bell_lead.name: Bell Lead
bell_lead.flavour: Rings faintly on the rocks on the way down.

cannon_shot.name: Cannon Shot
cannon_shot.flavour: Fired from the Marigold once. Now it fishes.

cork_float.name: Wine Cork
cork_float.flavour: From a bottle someone was very glad to finish.

glass_ball.name: Glass Ball Float
glass_ball.flavour: An old net float. It glows a little when something bites.

gut_leader.name: Gut Leader
gut_leader.flavour: A short tough length between the line and the hook.

silkweed_leader.name: Silkweed Leader
silkweed_leader.flavour: Invisible in the water, unbreakable in the hand.

tin_spoon.name: Tin Spoon
tin_spoon.flavour: A spoon with the handle sawn off. Flashes like a sardine.

feather_jig.name: Gull Feather Jig
feather_jig.flavour: Hops along the bottom like something wounded.

glass_minnow.name: Glass Minnow
glass_minnow.flavour: Blown glass, with a bubble for an eye.

ember_plug.name: Ember Plug
ember_plug.flavour: Warm to the touch. Hot-water fish go mad for it.

rune_spinner.name: Rune Spinner
rune_spinner.flavour: Its blade is carved with a glyph that hums underwater.

landing_net.name: Landing Net
landing_net.flavour: For the last metre, where most fish are lost.

gaff.name: Gaff
gaff.flavour: A hook on a pole, for the ones too big for the net.

polarized_glasses.name: Polarized Glasses
polarized_glasses.flavour: Cuts the glare. You see shadows under the surface.

tackle_box.name: Tackle Box
tackle_box.flavour: Spare hooks and sinkers, so a snap costs you less.

bait_bucket.name: Bait Bucket
bait_bucket.flavour: Keeps bait lively. Every stack lasts longer.
